text:
mia (sales): Hey team — APAC POC is blocked. Customer tests are hitting a model error: model not found / deprecated. They want to know if we can pin an older variant in APAC and whether KMS is available during trial. Also asking for pricing for fallback paths.

emily (sales-engineering): Can you paste the exact error and request id?

mia (sales): Error from swarm: HTTP 404: model_not_found (model_id: redwood-medium-v3) request_id: req_0a3b9f2e. Body: { "error": "model_not_available", "reason": "sunset", "suggested": ["redwood-medium-v2", "redwood-medium-quant"] }

ashok (solutions): They're calling a pinned model redwood-medium-v3 — we sunset that build in ap-southeast-1 last week. Options: route to v2 or quant variant. Quant gives lower latency/cost but may reduce answer fidelity. For strict parity, we'd need to provision v3 binaries in-region.

lee (eng-runtime): Quick notes: we don't have v3 binary images in ap-southeast-1. Two practical paths: 1) manual replica provisioning (eng-runtime can seed a replica, ~2-4h), 2) enable automatic routing fallback to redwood-medium-v2 (immediate). Which do you want?

lee (eng-runtime): Relevant log snippet:
```
2026-04-12T09:11:02Z ERROR model_loader: model redwood-medium-v3 not present in region ap-southeast-1 request=req_0a3b9f2e
```

sara (security): KMS/customer-managed keys are only available for Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted trial uses ephemeral keys and we cannot attach customer KMS for that environment. I posted the security questionnaire link (internal): https://redwood.internal/sec/qna

emily (sales-engineering): Pricing note: Dedicated trial we can offer a 30% off starter credit for month 1. Hosted fallback is billed at standard usage. Need expected QPS and average sequence length to firm up numbers.

mia (sales): Customer says peak ~5 QPS, avg 512 tokens. They also reported occasional 429s on burst.

ashok (solutions): For 5 QPS / 512 tokens, hosted fallback to v2 should be fine. 429s are likely quota bursts — suggest adding Retry-After handling client-side and I can file a temporary quota uplift.

deploy-bot: quota request #Q-48321 created by ashok; target region=ap-southeast-1, project=redwood-corp-poc, requested qps=8.

lee (eng-runtime): Short term: I'll push routing policy to fallback to redwood-medium-v2. Long term: schedule provisioning for v3 in APAC if the customer requires exact parity. If you want me to seed a replica now I can start the manual job.

mia (sales): Please enable fallback now. Ashok — please open the uplift. Emily — send the pricing sheet and security link to customer. I'll tell them ETA.

sara (security): For KMS + questionnaire: if they require CMK we need a Dedicated/Private contract and DPA addendum signed. I'll loop in legal if they press.

emily (sales-engineering): Shared draft quote: https://drive.redwood/poc-pricing/apac-poc-quote.xlsx :thumbsup:

mia (sales): Thanks. PM gave ok to share logs with eng (customer contact pm@redwoodcorp.com). I'll share minimal logs and request id.

lee (eng-runtime): Pushed fallback routing at 2026-04-12T09:18:30Z. I'll monitor for errors and quality regressions. If 429s persist after uplift, we'll adjust autoscaling rules.

deploy-bot: quota Q-48321 approved and applied to project redwood-corp-poc. New qps=8.

mia (sales): Customer confirmed they can continue with v2 fallback for now. They'll validate quality and report back. Closing this thread unless new regressions appear. :tada:
